items.description: The new African agency aims to bring greater transparency to credit ratings.

items.excerpt: The new African agency aims to bring greater transparency to credit ratings. Abuja, Nigeria – On October 7, the African Union officially launched the Africa Credit Rating Agency (AfCRA), bringing to fruition an initiative first endorsed by African leaders in 2017. The agency, based in Port Louis, Mauritius, is designed to provide independent assessments of African governments and corporate borrowers, drawing on local data and expertise to complement ratings issued by international agencies. items.imageCaption: Image caption, Drivers were limited to 25 laps for each set of tyres in last year's Qatar Grand Prix
items.author: Andrew Benson
items.excerpt: Formula 1 drivers will be limited to a maximum of 27 laps on a set of tyres at next weekend's Qatar Grand Prix. The decision is caused by concern over the integrity of the Pirelli tyres on the high-speed Lusail track, which has a series of demanding, long-duration corners. It means teams will have to make at least two pit stops during the 57-lap grand prix, as was the case last year. The limit applies on a single set of tyres whenever it is used across sessions. items.excerpt: Every morning for a month, Mildred Juarez woke up at five to be the first person in the showers at the immigration centre in Texas where she was being detained. Her friends had paid her bail, and she wanted to look presentable when she was finally released. Juarez was confused. Her friends had wired $2,600 (£1,970) to a bond company, Libre Immigration Services (LIS), that had been recommended by her lawyer. items.title: Magnitude 6.9 earthquake strikes Peru's Junin region
items.description: No immediate reports of casualties, significant damage
items.author: Merve Aydogan
items.excerpt: A magnitude 6.9 earthquake struck 22 kilometers (14 miles) west-northwest of Ondores in Peru's central Junin region on Friday, according to the US Geological Survey. The quake took place at 7.09 pm local time (0009GMT Saturday) at a depth of approximately 142.1 km (88 mi). The US National Tsunami Warning Center said that following the quake, there was no tsunami warning, advisory, watch or threat. There were no immediate reports of casualties or significant damage.

items.title: ANC fights to keep control of South Africa's key cities after election setback
items.description: The ANC appears reluctant to replicate its national power-sharing deal with the pro-business DA at the local level.

items.author: BBC News
items.excerpt: The party that has dominated South Africa for more than 30 years is in a race against time to secure power-sharing deals in most of the country's cities after a massive drop in its support in this month's local elections. The African National Congress (ANC) suffered its worst result since it came to power in 1994 when South Africa transitioned from the racist apartheid system to democracy. It won a majority in just one of the country's nine provinces, Limpopo, down from six in the last elections.
